1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 c6 3.d4 d5 4.exd5 cxd5 5.B.strategy: Saves the attacked bishop with check, so Black has to answer the check and the threat to take on e5 together. White gains time and trades the bishop for a piece that is not yet developed.

Blocks the check with the bishop and offers a trade. The b8-knight can recapture on d7 with a developing move that also defends e5, which is why Black can afford to leave that pawn alone for the moment.
